chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Sinan, from Salih ibn Uqba, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The most rightful of Allah's creatures to submit to what Allah has decreed is the one who knows Allah, and the one who is satisfied with the Decree; the Decree comes upon him, and Allah magnifies his reward. And the one who is displeased with the Decree, the Decree passes over him, and Allah nullifies his reward.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between those who are satisfied with God's decree and those who are displeased with it?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi links intellectual recognition of Allah (ma'rifah) with emotional acceptance (rida), establishing that true knowledge manifests in contentment with divine decree. It highlights the eschatological consequence of this state: those who accept Allah's will with gratitude see their spiritual reward elevated, whereas those who resent it incur the loss of their deeds. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the unity of gnosis and volition in achieving nearness to God.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Sinan, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said ‘The most rightful of the creatures of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is (one who) submits to whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Judged. The one who recognises Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and the one who is satisfied with the Judgement, the Judgement would come upon him anyway, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Magnify his Recompense; and the one who is angry with the Judgement, the Judgement would come upon him anyway, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Drop his Recompense’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Sinan from Salih ibn ‘Aqaba from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Ja’fi from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far (a.s.) has said, ‘

The most proper people to agree with the decisions of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, are those who have recognized Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy. Whoever agrees with the decision of Allah that is to take place anyway, Allah increases his reward. Whoever disagrees with the decision of Allah, the decision is, inevitably, applied to him but his reward becomes void.”’
